_readme: Phase E13 — recorded performance budgets (Article XVI: 'UI usable at a
year of incident volume'; roadmap: 'Performance baselines with recorded
Every budget states its own measurement semantics (OBS-2): what is
measured, over what window, from what source, and on what hardware the
number was recorded. A budget without those is a number nobody can
Budgets are CEILINGS FOR CI, not observed averages. They are set with
deliberate headroom — an order of magnitude in places — over the measured
local figure, so the suite fails on a structural regression (an accidental
O(n^2), a per-row query, a lost index) and not on a noisy 2-core shared
runner. The 'observed_local' field records what the machine below actually
measured on the date stated, so the headroom is visible rather than
implied, and a future tightening can be argued from real numbers.
The budgets are asserted by aeam/tests/test_phase_e13_performance.py and
gated by the 'performance' job in .github/workflows/deploy.yml. See
docs/PERFORMANCE_BASELINES.md for the methodology and the recorded run.

baseline_environment.database: SQLite (file-backed, tmp_path) — the CI-portable substitute for PostgreSQL
baseline_environment.llm: disabled (LLM_ENABLED=false) — all budgets measure AEAM's own code paths, never provider latency
baseline_environment.note: GitHub-hosted runners are 2-core and shared; the headroom below exists for exactly that gap.

concurrent_investigation_throughput.what: Orchestrator.handle_event() executed concurrently across worker threads, from dispatch to finalize_incident().
concurrent_investigation_throughput.why: Phase E2 proved per-incident state isolation under concurrency; this budget proves that isolation did not cost throughput.
concurrent_investigation_throughput.source: In-process wall clock around a ThreadPoolExecutor of 16 events, no DB/Redis/Qdrant.

ingestion_throughput.what: Document text extraction + chunking — the CPU-bound half of the ingestion pipeline.
ingestion_throughput.why: Embedding cost is a model property (TECH-6), not AEAM's; what AEAM owns is extraction and chunking, so that is what is budgeted.
ingestion_throughput.source: In-process wall clock around extraction.extract_text() + TextChunker.chunk_text().

console_query_at_volume.what: GET /api/v1/incidents/ paged response latency against a populated incidents table.
console_query_at_volume.why: Article XVI: 'Unbounded endpoints paginated; UI usable at a year of incident volume.' 5,000 incidents is a year at ~14/day.
console_query_at_volume.source: FastAPI TestClient wall clock, real SQLite, E6 pagination path.

autonomous_loop_stability.what: MonitorAgent poll-loop cycle cadence and heartbeat freshness over consecutive cycles.
autonomous_loop_stability.why: Phase E7 made the loop supervised; a loop that drifts or stalls is the failure mode supervision exists to catch.
autonomous_loop_stability.source: HeartbeatTracker ages sampled across cycles, with a stubbed poll body.
